prompt_md: In tic-tac-toe, treat first moves that match after rotating or flipping the board as the same move. How many truly different first moves are there?
prompt_short: Tic-tac-toe first moves, up to rotations and flips?
explain_intuition_md: Any corner turns into any other corner when you rotate the board, and the same goes for the edges. That leaves only three kinds of move: corner, edge and center.
